// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

// Note that some adapters may set a maximum length for the String type by default, please ensure your strings are long
// enough when changing adapters.
// See https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/prisma-schema-reference#string for more information
datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Session {
  id                   String   @id
  shop                 String
  state                String
  isOnline             Boolean
  scope                String?
  expires              DateTime?
  accessToken          String
  userId               BigInt?
  firstName            String?
  lastName             String?
  email                String?
  accountOwner         Boolean?
  locale               String?
  collaborator         Boolean?
  emailVerified        Boolean?
  refreshToken         String?
  refreshTokenExpires  DateTime?
}

model ZipCode {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  zipCode   String
  label     String?
  zone      String?
  message   String?
  eta       String?
  type         String   @default("allowed")
  isActive     Boolean  @default(true)
  codAvailable Boolean?
  returnPolicy String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, zipCode])
}

model DeliveryRule {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop          String
  name          String
  zone          String?
  zipCodes      String?  // comma-separated zip codes, or empty for "all in zone"
  minOrderAmount Float?
  deliveryFee   Float?
  freeShippingAbove Float?
  estimatedDays String?
  cutoffTime    String?  // e.g. "14:00" — orders after this go next day
  daysOfWeek    String?  // e.g. "Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri"
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  priority      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([shop])
}

model WaitlistEntry {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  name      String?
  email     String
  zipCode   String
  note      String?
  status    String   @default("waiting") // waiting, accepted, rejected, notified, converted
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, email, zipCode])
  @@index([shop])
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id                    String  @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String  @unique
  // Layout
  position              String  @default("inline") // inline, floating, popup
  // Colors
  primaryColor          String  @default("#008060")
  successColor          String  @default("#008060")
  errorColor            String  @default("#D72C0D")
  backgroundColor       String  @default("#FFFFFF")
  textColor             String  @default("#202223")
  // Text
  heading               String  @default("Check Delivery Availability")
  placeholder           String  @default("Enter your zip code")
  buttonText            String  @default("Check")
  successMessage        String  @default("Great news! We deliver to your area.")
  errorMessage          String  @default("Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.")
  notFoundMessage       String  @default("We currently do not ship to this ZIP code.")
  // Features
  showEta               Boolean @default(true)
  showZone              Boolean @default(false)
  showWaitlistOnFailure Boolean @default(false)
  showCod               Boolean @default(true)
  showReturnPolicy      Boolean @default(true)
  showCutoffTime        Boolean @default(true)
  showDeliveryDays      Boolean @default(true)
  blockCartOnInvalid    Boolean @default(false)
  blockCheckoutInCart   Boolean @default(false)
  showSocialProof       Boolean @default(true)
  // Border
  borderRadius          String  @default("8")
  // Custom CSS
  customCss             String?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Subscription {
  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String    @unique
  planId                String    @default("free")
  billingInterval       String    @default("monthly")
  shopifySubscriptionId String?
  status                String    @default("active")
  trialEndsAt           DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model ShopSettings {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop              String   @unique
  defaultBehavior   String   @default("block") // "block" = block all unlisted zips, "allow" = allow all unlisted zips
  notificationEmail String?  // email to receive waitlist notifications
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt
}

## Deep Plan: "Notify All Customers" Feature

### Current State Analysis

**What exists today:**
- A "Notify Waiting Customers by ZIP Code" card (lines 706-751 in `app.waitlist.tsx`) — shows each ZIP with waiting customers and a per-ZIP "Notify X Customers" button
- `notify-zip` action (lines 157-182) — marks all `waiting` entries for a specific ZIP as `notified`, returns their emails
- A result modal showing emails to copy or open in email client
- `bulk-notify` action (lines 133-155) — similar but uses a manual ZIP input modal
- Both bulk actions are gated to Pro/Ultimate plans only

**What the screenshot requests:**
A "Notify All" button to notify **all** waiting customers across **all** ZIP codes in one click, instead of doing it ZIP by ZIP.

---

### Comprehensive Plan (All Angles)

#### 1. The Core Problem
When a merchant has 10+ ZIP codes with waiting customers, clicking "Notify X Customers" on each ZIP individually is tedious. They need:
- **One-click "Notify All"** — mark ALL waiting customers across all ZIPs as notified
- **See all emails at once** — copy/email them in bulk
- **Confirmation before acting** — this is a destructive action (can't un-notify)

#### 2. UX Design (Customer Perspective)

**A. Add "Notify All Customers" button at the top of the ZIP notify card:**
- Placed above the per-ZIP list, clearly visible
- Shows total count: "Notify All (47 Customers)"
- Opens a confirmation modal before executing

**B. Confirmation Modal:**
- Shows breakdown: "You are about to notify 47 customers across 5 ZIP codes"
- Lists the ZIP codes and counts as a summary
- Warning: "This will mark all waiting customers as notified. This action cannot be undone."
- Primary action: "Notify All 47 Customers"
- Secondary: "Cancel"

**C. Result Modal (after notifying):**
- Shows success: "Notified 47 customers across 5 ZIP codes"
- All emails listed in a copyable text field
- "Copy All Emails" button
- "Open in Email Client" button (mailto: link with all emails)
- Per-ZIP breakdown of how many were notified

#### 3. Technical Implementation

**Backend (action):**
- New intent: `"notify-all"` in the action function
- Finds ALL waiting entries for the shop (not filtered by ZIP)
- Updates them all to `notified` status
- Returns: `{ emails, count, zipBreakdown: [{zipCode, count}] }`
- Same Pro/Ultimate plan gate as existing bulk-notify

**Frontend:**
- Add a "Notify All Customers" button at the top of the ZIP notify card
- Add confirmation modal with breakdown
- Reuse/extend the existing result modal to handle multi-ZIP results

#### 4. Edge Cases
- **No waiting customers** — button disabled/hidden
- **Only 1 ZIP with waiters** — still works, just simpler
- **Large email lists (500+)** — mailto: links have URL length limits (~2000 chars), so only show "Copy Emails" for large lists, hide "Open in Email Client"
- **Concurrent actions** — disable button while fetcher is loading
- **Plan gating** — same as existing: Pro/Ultimate only

#### 5. What NOT to over-engineer
- No email sending from the app itself (merchants use their own email)
- No undo/revert (same as current per-ZIP notify)
- No partial selection (that would be checkbox-based bulk actions, different feature)

---

## Plan: Redesign Waitlist with Bulk Select + Selective Notify

### The Problem You're Describing

A merchant has 100 waiting customers across 5 ZIP codes (20 each). They only expanded shipping to **1 area**. Right now:
- "Notify All" blasts all 100 — **wrong**, they only want those 20
- Per-ZIP buttons work but there's no way to **select multiple specific ZIPs** (e.g. notify 2 out of 5 areas)
- No bulk actions on the **individual entries table** (can't select 15 specific customers and notify/delete/accept them)

### The Solution: Two-Level Bulk Selection

---

#### **Part A: ZIP Code Notify Card — Checkbox Selection**

Replace the current list of ZIP rows with a **selectable list with checkboxes**:

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Notify Waiting Customers by ZIP Code                           │
│  Select ZIP codes where you've expanded delivery.               │
│                                                                 │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ ☑ Select All (5 ZIP codes, 100 customers)               │   │
│  ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤   │
│  │ ☐  380001    20 customers waiting                       │   │
│  │ ☑  380015    20 customers waiting                       │   │
│  │ ☐  380054    20 customers waiting                       │   │
│  │ ☑  390001    20 customers waiting                       │   │
│  │ ☐  400001    20 customers waiting                       │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                 │
│  [Notify 40 Customers in 2 Selected ZIP Codes]   (primary btn) │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**How it works:**
- Each ZIP row has a **Checkbox** on the left
- **"Select All"** checkbox at the top toggles all
- The primary button at the bottom dynamically updates: `"Notify 40 Customers in 2 Selected ZIP Codes"`
- Button is disabled when nothing is selected
- Clicking triggers the confirmation modal showing only selected ZIPs + their counts
- Backend receives an array of selected ZIP codes, notifies only those

---

#### **Part B: Waitlist Table — IndexTable with Bulk Actions**

├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
